INSTITUTE_FIRST.label: Preferred countries win
INSTITUTE_FIRST.hint: The list above decides. The country a form is opened from is used only if you have selected no preferred countries — so a form opened in Russia starts on +7 rather than defaulting to India.

GEO_FIRST.label: Follow the visitor's country
GEO_FIRST.hint: The country a form is opened from is pre-selected; your preferred countries still order the rest of the picker. Best when you take enrolments from several countries.

INSTITUTE_ONLY.label: Preferred countries only
INSTITUTE_ONLY.hint: Never look at where a form is opened from. Choose this if every phone number you collect belongs to one country.

googleSignIn.guideIntro: About 30 minutes of work, then 2–3 working days for Google's review. You need a Google account, access to your domain's DNS, and a public website for your brand.
googleSignIn.privacyFallback: your privacy policy URL (https://<your learner portal>/privacy-policy)

project.title: Create a Google Cloud project
project.body: Open console.cloud.google.com/projectcreate, name it after your brand and click Create. Check that the new project is selected at the top of the page.

owner.title: Add Vacademy as a project Owner
owner.body: IAM & Admin → IAM → Grant access → {{account}} → Role: Basic → Owner → Save. Google sign-in finishes on vacademy.io, and Google only verifies your app when a project owner has verified that domain.

consent.title: Start the OAuth consent screen
consent.body: APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → Get started. App name: your brand exactly as written on your website. Audience: External. Add your contact email, accept the policy, then Create.

branding.title: Fill in Branding
branding.body: Logo: square, 120×120 px. Home page: your public website. Privacy policy: {{privacyUrl}}. Authorized domains: your website's domain and vacademy.io. Then Save.

scopes.title: Add the three sign-in scopes
scopes.body: Data Access → Add or remove scopes → tick only userinfo.email, userinfo.profile and openid → Update → Save. Any other scope makes Google's review take weeks.

client.title: Create the OAuth client
client.body: Clients → Create client → Web application → Authorized redirect URIs → add {{redirectUri}} → Create. Download the JSON straight away: Google shows the secret only once.

domain.title: Verify your domain
domain.body: Google Search Console → Add property → Domain → your domain. Add the TXT record it gives you at your DNS provider, then click Verify. DNS can take up to an hour.

footer.title: Link the privacy policy from your website
footer.body: Add a footer link on your home page to {{privacyUrl}}. Google rejects apps whose home page does not link to the privacy policy.

publish.title: Publish the app
publish.body: Audience → Publish app → Confirm. The status changes to "In production".

verify.title: Submit for verification
verify.body: Verification Center → submit for brand verification. Google usually replies by email within 2–3 working days. Answer any questions quickly.

save.title: Paste the client here
save.body: When Verification Center shows "Verified", paste the Client ID and Client secret above and click Save. Then try "Continue with Google" on your learner portal: Google should show your brand's name.

validation.clientIdRequired: Enter the Client ID from your Google OAuth client
validation.clientSecretRequired: Enter the Client secret from your Google OAuth client
